newsitem.title: UK: UK physical grain slightly higher in slow trade.
newsitem.headline: UK physical grain slightly higher in slow trade.

text.p: UK physical grain markets drifted quietly into the weekend on Friday with values around 0.50 stg up from Thursday.
"There is not much happening, it's Friday and noone can really be bothered," said a trader.
Delivered feed wheat was around 0.50 stg up with pre-Christmas material fetching 96 to 97 stg in East Anglia with 100 stg being paid for New Year delivery.
In the Avon range 95.50 stg was paid for November and 97 stg for December.
In Norfolk/Suffolk feed barley traded at 99.50 stg for Jan/Mar.
No milling wheat business was reported.
On the fob market values were 0.25 stg to 0.50 stg up with no business reported.
